# Widget reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-widget-docs.mjs from the files in /schemas. Do not edit by hand; run `npm run docs`. -->

The built-in widgets (66), grouped by what they are for. Every widget has the same outer shape
(`id`, `type`, `v`, `data`, and the optional `style`, `action`, `analytics`, `rules`, `fallback`; see the README). The tables below describe
the `data` of each widget. A field marked **required** must be there; the others may be left out.

## Basics

### `text`

A line or paragraph of text. (version 1)

| Field | Holds | |
|---|---|---|
| `text` | text | **required** |
| `maxLines` | whole number (1 to …) |  |

### `image`

A picture from a web address. (version 1)

| Field | Holds | |
|---|---|---|
| `url` | web address | **required** |
| `alt` | text |  |
| `aspectRatio` | number (0 to …) |  |
| `fit` | `cover` or `contain` |  |

### `button`

A button that runs an action. (version 1)

| Field | Holds | |
|---|---|---|
| `label` | text | **required** |
| `variant` | `filled` or `outline` or `text` |  |

### `spacer`

Empty space between things. (version 1)

| Field | Holds | |
|---|---|---|
| `size` | spacing name | **required** |

### `divider`

A thin line between things. (version 1)

No fields.

### `rich_text`

A sentence with bold, italic or coloured parts. (version 1)

| Field | Holds | |
|---|---|---|
| `spans` | list of object with `text`, `bold`, `italic`, `underline`, `color`, `size`, at least 1 | **required** |

### `icon`

A single icon. (version 1)

| Field | Holds | |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | icon name | **required** |
| `size` | size name |  |

### `badge`

A small coloured label such as New or Sale. (version 1)

| Field | Holds | |
|---|---|---|
| `label` | text | **required** |
| `tone` | tone name |  |

### `section_header`

### `carousel`

Widgets side by side that you swipe through (can move by itself). (version 1)

| Field | Holds | |
|---|---|---|
| `items` | list of a widget, at least 1 | **required** |

## Live data

### `data_list`

A list filled with rows from your own API, using a template. (version 1)

A list filled with live data. The app asks its own API for rows (`source.name` is a name the app understands, like "doctors_nearby") and repeats `template` once per row. Inside the template, {{field}} is replaced by that row's value. Placeholders work in text, URLs and action params.

| Field | Holds | |
|---|---|---|
| `source` | object with `name`, `params` | **required** |
| `template` | list of a widget, at most 1, at least 1 | **required** |
| `layout` | `list` or `carousel` or `grid` |  |
| `columns` | whole number (1 to 6) |  |
| `emptyText` | text |  |
